title: Wasar pampan Quri tuqit jiskʼachasir jaqi
intro: Mä jach’a wasar pampan campamento ukar mä juk’a suyt’añan ukat jan yatiñanjam amuyt’añäni. Mä jach’a irpirix Divino ukamp tantachasiñatakiw sarawayxi, mä ayllun jaytawayi, kunatix mä uñjkañ yänak katxaruñ munapxi. Uka jan samarañ samart’añanxa, mä amuyt’ayir jaqiw nayrar sartaski, k’ajkir arsuwinakampi ukat mä ch’ikhi lurawimpi, ukax jakkirjamawa.
clues: Nayajj khitinakatï Musa jilatampi Egipto markat sarjjapjjäna ukanakat maynïrïtwa, lamar qotajj qhespiñasatak tʼaqanuqtatap uñjasa.
Nayax uñjirïtwa kunapachatix p’iqinchirisax pusi tunk arumaw qullu pataruw irnaqir saratayna.
Mä vaca qalluruw modayäta, uka vacajj mä jiskʼa istʼasirïnwa, ukat ukaruw jaqenakar jawsayäta.
Uka yatiyirin pistapat mä ampar laqʼa apsusinjja, kuntï lurawaykta ukaruw jaqontayäta.
Musa jupampiw uñkatasiwayta ukat ‘janiw llamkt’apxitati’ sañajatakiw juchañchapxitu ukat sapak jakasiñatakiw juchañchapxitu, mä tantachäwiw taripañatak arsutäna.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
